description: Score a foreground/background pair for readability. Reports the WCAG 2.2 ratio with AA/AAA verdicts and the APCA Lc value, which is the better guide for dark themes where WCAG 2.x passes pairs that are hard to read.

background.description: Background colour in the same formats.

foreground.description: Text colour as #rgb, #rrggbb, or rgb(r, g, b).

name: check_contrast
